title: Virtual reality and stimulation of touch and smell for inducing relaxation: A randomized controlled trial
reading_scope: Author manuscript: Methods 2.1–2.7, Results 3, Discussion and Conclusions, Figure 3, Table 1. Table 1 pages 22–23 and Figure 3 page 20 rendered and visually checked.

sample.population: Adults screened to exclude clinical anxiety/depression symptoms

reported_tests.location: Results 3; manuscript page 10; precise F/p not printed for this comparison

implementation.vr: 4×3 m projected screen, HD projector, 5.1 surround sound, Wiimote; not a head-mounted display
implementation.olfactory: Lavender scent with ceramic diffuser, unscented candle and water; ambient presentation
implementation.session: Approximately 60 min for the whole session including assessments and training; not a verified 60 min VR exposure

interpretation: The whole procedure was followed by higher reported relaxation in all four groups. This experiment did not establish extra relaxation or presence benefit from its additional scent/touch conditions. It does not establish equivalence or rule out benefit from different delivery, populations or tasks.
limitations: Non-clinical population and initially fairly high relaxation scores
No non-VR/no-intervention arm; pre-post change cannot isolate VR itself from music, narrative and the rest of the procedure
Projection-based VR with simple ambient diffusion, rather than modern precisely synchronized wearable output
Only one emotion-induction procedure, short-term subjective outcomes
No precise between-group F/p supplied for relaxation in the manuscript Results
manuscript_note: Methods 2.6 prose interchanges tactile/olfactory explanations of the Smell and Touch labels. Figure 3 and Methods 2.7 clearly match Smell with lavender and Touch with artificial grass; labels/data above follow those unambiguous descriptions. Preserve this note in source verification.
reuse: Numeric facts may be redrawn with attribution. The downloaded author manuscript and page images remain in private/; no redistribution licence was confirmed for those scans.
